title: "Gallery"

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  dev.args = list(bg = "white"),
  collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 150, fig.width = 7
)
```

Every map tidymapr draws. Each entry has three tabs: the map, the tidy
table behind it, and the code. Maps use the colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito
palette and `theme_tidymapr()`, which matches
`tidydiversity::theme_tidydiversity()`. Site coordinates from
`geo_example_sites()` are illustrative; replace them with your own GPS.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidymapr)
library(tidydiversity)
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(1)
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm")
```

## Study-site map {.tabset}

### Map

```{r sites, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Study sites along Mt Wilhelm coloured by elevation band, with labels, scale bar and north arrow"}
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

### Table

```{r sites-table}
sites
```

### Code

```r
sites <- geo_example_sites("wilhelm")
plot_sites(sites, lon, lat, colour = elevation_band, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

### Map


```{r sites-tiles-table}
sites[c("site", "lon", "lat", "elevation")]
```

### Code

```r
# "osm", "carto", "carto_dark" and "esri" tiles; falls back to "coast" offline

```

## Hill numbers on a map {.tabset}

```{r hill-data, include = FALSE}
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season)
est <- dplyr::left_join(est, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
est_dry <- est[est$season == "dry", ]
```

### Map

```{r hill-map, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.alt = "Observed ant richness at each Mt Wilhelm site in the dry season"}
plot_geo(est_dry, estimate, lon, lat, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

### Table

```{r hill-table}
est_dry
```

### Code

```r
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season)
est <- dplyr::left_join(est, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
plot_geo(est[est$season == "dry", ], estimate, lon, lat, label = site, basemap = "coast")
```

## Distance decay {.tabset}

```{r decay-data, include = FALSE}
com <- dplyr::left_join(png_ants, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
decay <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
```

### Plot

```{r decay, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4, fig.alt = "Pairwise ant dissimilarity against great-circle distance by season"}
autoplot(decay)
```

### Table

```{r decay-table}
decay
```

### Code

```r
com <- dplyr::left_join(png_ants, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
decay <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
autoplot(decay)
```

## Species distribution model {.tabset}

```{r sdm-data, include = FALSE}
grid <- expand.grid(
  lon = seq(145, 145.5, length.out = 20),
  lat = seq(-5.9, -5.5, length.out = 16)
)
grid$bio1 <- 15 + 12 * (grid$lat - min(grid$lat)) / diff(range(grid$lat))
pa <- grid
pa$present <- as.integer(pa$bio1 > 22)
fit <- sdm_fit(pa, predictors = "bio1", present = present, engine = "glm")
```

### Map

```{r sdm, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4.5, fig.alt = "Predicted habitat suitability for a simulated species present only at high bio1"}
plot_sdm(sdm_predict(fit, newdata = grid), basemap = "none")
```

### Evaluation

```{r sdm-table}
sdm_evaluate(fit)
```

### Code

```r
fit <- sdm_fit(pa, predictors = "bio1", present = present, engine = "glm")
sdm_evaluate(fit)
plot_sdm(sdm_predict(fit, newdata = grid), basemap = "none")
```
